insufficientBalance.title: Not enough balance
insufficientBalance.body: Top up your wallet to purchase this pack.

odds.title: Pull rates
odds.redistribution: If a tier sells out, its share is split proportionally across the tiers that still have cards.

rarity.subtitle: Every card this tier can give you.

fair.title: Provably fair
fair.subtitle: The odds above are not a promise — they are checkable.
fair.commitBody: Your pull is locked to a drand randomness round that has not been published yet — so nobody, us included, can know the outcome when you pay.
fair.beaconBody: Seconds later the public drand network publishes that round. It is run by independent operators, so the number cannot be steered.
fair.verifyBody: Your card is derived from that published number, and every pull comes with a receipt you can verify yourself.

lifecycle.title: After you pull
lifecycle.subtitle: Keep it, cash it, or take it home.
lifecycle.vaultBody: The exact card you pulled is held under your name — a graded slab keeps its PSA certificate.
lifecycle.buybackBody: Every card carries a buyback price up front. Take it whenever you like and the credit is immediate.
lifecycle.shipBody: Request delivery and it is sent to you, tracked — a graded slab still sealed in its case.

topUpHint: Not enough balance — tap to top up.

beacon.title: A signature you can check
beacon.verified: Verified in your browser against drand’s published key. Only the drand network could have produced it.
beacon.unverified: This signature did not verify. Please tell us — that is a bug.
beacon.pinned: The key is built into this page, not served by us — check it against drand yourself:
beacon.unreachable: Couldn’t reach drand from this browser. That does not affect a pull — every receipt can be checked the same way afterwards.

seed.label: Your seed
seed.hint: Mixed into the commitment before the beacon exists. Change it to anything you like — it appears on your receipt.
